if doc.custom_default_purchase_rate:
    # 1. Define the Price List name (Ensure this exists in your system)
    price_list = "Standard Buying"
    
    # 2. Check if a Purchase Price already exists for this Item and Stock UOM
    price_name = frappe.db.get_value("Item Price", {
        "item_code": doc.name,
        "price_list": price_list,
        "uom": doc.stock_uom
    })

    if price_name:
        # Update the existing record
        frappe.db.set_value("Item Price", price_name, "price_list_rate", doc.custom_default_purchase_rate)
    else:
        # Create a new Item Price record
        new_price = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Item Price",
            "item_code": doc.name,
            "price_list": price_list,
            "price_list_rate": doc.custom_default_purchase_rate,
            "uom": doc.stock_uom
        })
        new_price.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
    # Optional: Log the update for debugging
    # frappe.msgprint(f"Updated {price_list} to {doc.custom_default_purchase_rate}")
